<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Opposition challenges voter rolls:</strong> The INDIA bloc has moved the Supreme Court demanding an audit of voter rolls and a stay on recent revisions, following mass protests led by Rahul Gandhi over the alleged removal of 130 million names.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOeWFoTzV2QXNmWWxWb09NaXZmYUpDb3hVZEdHWjBib0RJRGs5el90MnJxVEd5YjR6eE96XzRtTEJlZW1uUjNyaEl5VkxrbjZ6Y251LTZNZFk1MFFrZFg2Q3ZLVWRvb1N3WXIzUzlrSGlIVFVzY05LVDZSdml1NHBaSVg0cHRvUmZpRlJPUmRfSEN4QQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxPMVVhU3kzTTNtdUtueXZyUFN6LURKNzVEbzJXU0g4OE1odE9mVDRYeUtpTmZQWWZ0OU5vaHE1QjRTTjZ3RmVjSWk4V1RSWGtwZGVld2JjN0VCQmptaGRmSVZwR0VWUDRoeTdPd28zWGNsWkZGZkpNcExQcnNBYzlhQTRmWDNNOUJHYWNGR0VNSmlyVi1uallLZEp6UUJ5NDN3R1UwSEdrM1lwVnZpclBEc1hR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legal hurdles for opposition plea:</strong> The Supreme Court registry has flagged 14 procedural defects, including missing documentation and fee shortfalls, in the petition filed by Rahul Gandhi regarding electoral roll revisions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNSG1nei13XzV3OE1BVGRuazdlT2UwempIem5VaVhnZzNELWI0Vk1tdDZWcFRSX0IwMTlPU0FSVWdPN1A0WWRYbGk2Nks3OWMzYlo4cVliRllrRklOUXdSZ2U2QWFmQVA1MFR0RnVvQ1p2ZkhRQ0NpVHBvYTNGVnE5NkpIWDBSeDRjSjBaWVItS1FGMlZLSmxGX1UwT2pHN2dIWUJqa3FCZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
